sections.h2: A local painting contractor for Micanopy
body: Precision Paint Experts is a locally owned, licensed, bonded, and fully insured painting contractor serving Micanopy, FL from our base in Newberry. We have more than 15 years of painting experience, our own crews do every job, and the crew lead who prices your project is the one who runs it.

Micanopy asks for a different pace than a new subdivision. The town's pre-war houses and antique shops have been painted many times over many decades, and a fast spray-and-go approach does them no favors. What they need is patient scraping, honest carpentry repair, flexible caulking, and colors that respect the building.

sections.h2: Micanopy's buildings: pre-war homes and old storefronts
body: In the Historic District, most of our work is on older wood-sided homes with porches, tall windows, and plenty of trim. Layers of old paint have often built up on sills, railings, and window casings, and the bottom edges of siding and door frames are where rot shows up first. Out toward Tuscawilla Preserve and along the McIntosh corridor, the houses vary more in age and style, so the crew lead sizes up each one on its own terms rather than assuming a historic-district approach.

Downtown, the antique shops and small commercial buildings bring storefront trim, signage areas, doors, and masonry that need careful cleaning and a finish that suits their age. You can explore period-appropriate palettes in our article on historic paint colors from nearby Gainesville.

Micanopy's oak-shaded streets are a big part of its charm and a real factor in how paint performs. Shade keeps walls and roofs damp long after a storm, so mildew and algae move in on north and east faces, porch ceilings, and anything under a heavy limb. Leaves and debris collect in gutters and overflow onto fascia. Then summer adds humidity above 75% for months and afternoon storms several days a week.

Paint lasts here when the prep deals with moisture first. We treat mildew at the root, take moisture readings on suspicious wood, replace soft boards rather than coat them, and give the newly painted surfaces two full coats of 100% acrylic, or penetrating stain where wood should look like wood.

sections.h2: What working with us in Micanopy looks like
body: It starts with a walkthrough, usually scheduled within 48 hours. A crew lead measures, photographs conditions, and takes moisture readings, then sends a written, itemized estimate, typically within one business day. It lists surfaces included and excluded, prep steps, primer and topcoat products, number of coats, and the schedule. Nothing is added without your written approval.

Work usually begins one to three weeks after you approve. Prep days come before any paint, and on an older home they can make up a large share of the job. You do not have to move out for interior work, exterior projects are best scheduled October through May, and every job ends with a punch walk you sign. Exterior work carries a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, and you keep labelled touch-up paint.

From Micanopy our crews regularly head north to Gainesville, west to Archer, and east to Hawthorne. South across the county line, we also work in Ocala and the rest of Marion County. The full list is on our service areas page.
